resources.string: As soon as the bike is switched on
Tap Connect once with the bike on to pair the display for automatic connection.
Paused by Disconnect until the bike is switched off and on again, or you tap Connect.
Disconnect lasts until the bike is switched off and on again.
No location: rides are recorded without a GPS track and the automatic light cannot compute sunset.
Only approximate location: ride tracks will be coarse.
No notifications: the connection runs without a visible status notification.
Bluetooth permissions are required to connect to the display.
